title: Pathogenic Bacteria and Enzymes Involved in Stress and Metabolism
summary: This cluster consists of two pathogenic bacteria, Escherichia and Francisella, and several enzymes and metabolic pathways. Escherichia is involved in assimilatory sulfate reduction and sulfonate-sulfur utilization, while Francisella is associated with environmental and pathogenic species and glutathione utilization. The bacteria are connected to various enzymes and pathways, including copper- and zinc-containing superoxide dismutase, which is related to oxidative stresses and Cu/ZnSOD. Additionally, Cell Host Microbe is linked to methionine uptake, suggesting a relationship between the bacteria and their host.
